As Project Engineer for Pressure Control you sit where engineering meets delivery. You work up pressure-control packages, diffusers, vent silencers, pulsation dampeners and pressure vessels, and you steer them through procurement and production to a delivered, documented system. What you'll do - Engineer pressure-control packages from specification into a buildable, documented scope. - Coordinate procurement of materials and bought-in components against the project schedule. - Bridge design, production and QA, resolving technical questions as they arise. - Maintain the technical documentation: drawings, datasheets, certification and as-built records. - Track progress, flag risks early, and keep the project manager and customer informed. - Support inspection, testing and delivery of the finished equipment. What you bring - An HBO-level degree in mechanical or process engineering, or equivalent experience. - A few years in a project or design engineering role, ideally around pressure equipment or process systems. - The ability to read and produce technical drawings and datasheets. - Familiarity with procurement processes and, ideally, PED requirements. - A proactive, organised style: you keep many small things on track without being chased. - Professional English; Dutch is a plus.
